spans.s:
शिच् f. (-शिक्) The string of a pole for carrying burdens.
 E. श्रंस् to fall,
deriv. irr.: see शिक्य ।

षिच्(औ)षिचौ r. 6th cl. (सिञ्चति-ते)
 1. To sprinkle.
 2. To moisten, to
water, (as plants.)
 3. To pour out.
 4. To pour in. With अभि
prefixed, 1. To anoint, to initiate.
 2. To sprinkle. With उद्, 1.
To sprinkle.
 2. To make proud. With नि, 1. To pour.
 2. To im-
pregnate. With परि, To pour round.

सिच् f. (-सिक्) Clothes.
 E. षिच् to sprinkle, aff. क्विप् ।

सिचय m. (-यः)
 1. Cloth, clothes.
 2. Old or ragged raiment.
 E. षिचि to
cause to sprinkle, aff. श ।

सिच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being sprinkled.
 E. षिच् to sprinkle, pass. v., शानच् aff.
